data_privacy.title: Data privacy
data_privacy.requirement: Tool must have a publicly accessible privacy policy that clearly states what user data is collected, how it is processed, and how long it is retained. The policy must reference GDPR, the right to erasure, or an equivalent data protection framework.
data_privacy.basic_requirement: Can you find a privacy policy that explains what data the tool collects, what it does with your data, and whether it follows GDPR or similar protections? Provide a screenshot or link as evidence.

training_policy.title: Training policy
training_policy.requirement: Vendor must explicitly state that user queries/inputs/uploads are NOT used to train future models.
training_policy.basic_requirement: Does the tool promise (in writing) that your questions and files won't be used to improve their AI?

citation_mechanism.title: Citation mechanism
citation_mechanism.requirement: Tool must provide inline citations as its standard output format for AI-generated claims. Occasional uncited claims are acceptable but must be the exception, not the rule. Cited claims must link to real, accessible sources.
citation_mechanism.basic_requirement: Does the tool show where its information comes from? Look for clickable references that actually work. It's okay if a few claims lack citations, but most should have them.

compliance.title: Accessibility
compliance.requirement: Tool must support keyboard navigation to all major features, allow text resizing to at least 200% without content loss, and provide alt text for images. An accessibility statement or conformance claim (e.g., WCAG 2.1 AA) is strong supporting evidence.
compliance.basic_requirement: Can you use the tool with just a keyboard? Can you make the text bigger without breaking the layout? Do images have descriptions? Mark pass if you can confirm at least keyboard navigation works and the tool provides an accessibility statement.

data_source_clarity.title: Data source clarity
data_source_clarity.0: Sources are opaque — no information about what the tool indexes.
data_source_clarity.1: General source types mentioned (e.g., 'scientific articles', 'patents') but no specific databases named.
data_source_clarity.2: Key databases, publishers, or indices are identified by name.
data_source_clarity.3: Complete list of indexed sources with coverage dates and update frequency.
data_source_clarity.0_basic: No information about where the tool gets its data.
data_source_clarity.1_basic: The tool mentions what kind of sources it uses (e.g., 'scientific articles') but gives no specifics.
data_source_clarity.2_basic: The tool names the specific databases or publishers it searches.
data_source_clarity.3_basic: The tool provides a complete list of all its sources, including how recently they were updated.

methodology_disclosure.title: Methodology disclosure
methodology_disclosure.0: Black box — no explanation of how the tool works.
methodology_disclosure.1: Vague claims of using 'AI' without specifying what kind.
methodology_disclosure.2: Names the underlying model or technology (e.g., 'GPT-4', 'BERT-based search') and describes the retrieval approach at a high level.
methodology_disclosure.3: Documents the full pipeline: retrieval method, ranking/filtering, generation model, and any post-processing steps.
methodology_disclosure.0_basic: No explanation of how the tool works.
methodology_disclosure.1_basic: The tool just says it uses 'AI' without explaining what that means.
methodology_disclosure.2_basic: The tool names the specific AI technology it uses (e.g., a language model) and explains how it finds information.
methodology_disclosure.3_basic: The tool fully documents its process step by step: how it retrieves information, which AI model it uses, and how it generates answers.

accuracy_and_hallucination.title: Accuracy and hallucination
accuracy_and_hallucination.0: Multiple fabricated claims or citations per session — the tool routinely generates information that cannot be verified in the source literature.
accuracy_and_hallucination.1: Occasional errors — the tool is mostly correct but sometimes gets details wrong (misattributed findings, incorrect citation details, or minor factual errors).
accuracy_and_hallucination.2: High accuracy with only minor nuances missed — claims are verifiable and citations point to real papers, though synthesis may oversimplify complex findings.
accuracy_and_hallucination.3: Consistently accurate across all tested queries — no fabricated claims, no fake citations, and synthesis accurately reflects the source material.
accuracy_and_hallucination.0_basic: The tool often makes up facts, citations, or statistics that don't match the real literature.
accuracy_and_hallucination.1_basic: The tool is mostly correct but sometimes gets details wrong — wrong author, wrong year, or slightly off conclusions.
accuracy_and_hallucination.2_basic: The tool is accurate most of the time, with only small mistakes that don't change the overall meaning.
accuracy_and_hallucination.3_basic: The tool consistently provides correct, verified information — everything checks out against the original sources.

variance_consistency.title: Output consistency
variance_consistency.0: Core claims change between runs — asking the same question twice produces substantively different conclusions.
variance_consistency.1: Moderate variation — the same query sometimes yields noticeably different results, requiring re-prompting to get a reliable answer.
variance_consistency.2: Consistent core claims with minor surface variation — the substance is the same but phrasing or source selection may differ slightly.
variance_consistency.3: Highly reproducible — the tool produces substantively equivalent answers (same claims, same sources) across repeated runs.
variance_consistency.0_basic: Asking the same question twice gives completely different answers with different conclusions.
variance_consistency.1_basic: Answers vary noticeably — you often need to ask again to get a good result.
variance_consistency.2_basic: The main answers are consistent, though the wording or specific sources may differ slightly.
variance_consistency.3_basic: The tool gives reliable, repeatable answers — same substance every time you ask the same question.

workflow_integration.title: Workflow integration
workflow_integration.3: Seamless integration (e.g., direct Zotero/EndNote push, API hooks).
workflow_integration.0_basic: No way to save or export your results.
workflow_integration.1_basic: You can only copy and paste results manually.
workflow_integration.2_basic: You can export references in standard formats (like BibTeX or RIS).
workflow_integration.3_basic: The tool connects directly to reference managers (like Zotero) or other research tools.

cognitive_guardrails.title: Critical thinking prompts
cognitive_guardrails.0: Presents AI outputs as authoritative facts with no caveats, no source visibility, and no prompting toward verification.
cognitive_guardrails.1: Includes a generic disclaimer (e.g., 'AI may make mistakes', 'always verify sources') but does not actively surface source material.
cognitive_guardrails.2: Surfaces source material alongside generated text — the user can see original excerpts and compare them to the tool's summary.
cognitive_guardrails.3: Actively prompts the user to verify, compare, or evaluate — e.g., confidence indicators, explicit verification prompts, source comparison tools, or built-in fact-checking aids.
cognitive_guardrails.0_basic: The tool presents answers as final facts with no warnings or source links.
cognitive_guardrails.1_basic: There's a generic warning to 'verify the sources' but nothing else.
cognitive_guardrails.2_basic: The tool shows original source text alongside its answers so you can compare them.
cognitive_guardrails.3_basic: The tool actively helps you think critically — prompting you to compare sources, check for bias, or verify claims with built-in tools.

algorithmic_fairness.title: Algorithmic fairness
algorithmic_fairness.0: No evidence that the tool considers fairness — results appear systematically skewed (e.g., exclusively English-language, Western-published sources) without acknowledgment.
algorithmic_fairness.1: The tool acknowledges potential bias but provides no concrete evidence of mitigation efforts or diverse source coverage.
algorithmic_fairness.2: The tool demonstrates diverse source coverage in results (e.g., surfaces non-English or non-Western research for relevant queries) OR documents active bias mitigation measures.
algorithmic_fairness.3: The tool both demonstrates diverse results AND publishes transparency reports on source coverage, geographic scope, and fairness metrics.
algorithmic_fairness.0_basic: Results appear systematically biased and the tool doesn't acknowledge it.
algorithmic_fairness.1_basic: The tool mentions that bias might exist but doesn't show evidence of doing anything about it.
algorithmic_fairness.2_basic: The tool either shows diverse results in practice or documents how it tries to be fair.
algorithmic_fairness.3_basic: The tool both shows diverse results and publishes reports about its fairness efforts and source coverage.

data_handling.title: Data handling practices
data_handling.0: No transparency about data retention, encryption, or breach notification — privacy policy is vague or missing on these topics.
data_handling.1: Privacy policy exists but provides only generic statements about data protection without specifics on retention or security.
data_handling.2: Clearly states data retention periods and encryption practices (e.g., 'data stored for 30 days', 'encrypted at rest').
data_handling.3: Comprehensive data handling documentation: retention periods, encryption standards, breach notification policy, data residency, and user data export/deletion options.
data_handling.0_basic: No clear information about how long your data is kept or how it's protected.
data_handling.1_basic: The privacy policy exists but is vague about data retention and security.
data_handling.2_basic: The tool clearly states how long it keeps your data and that it uses encryption.
data_handling.3_basic: The tool provides full details: how long data is kept, how it's encrypted, what happens if there's a data breach, and how you can delete your data.

source_attribution_depth.title: Source attribution depth
source_attribution_depth.1: Links to journal landing pages only.
source_attribution_depth.3: Deep links to specific paragraphs or segments (RAG-level).
source_attribution_depth.0_basic: Sources are missing or links don't work.
source_attribution_depth.1_basic: Links only go to the journal homepage, not to the specific article.
source_attribution_depth.2_basic: Links take you to the specific article's abstract page.
source_attribution_depth.3_basic: Links take you directly to the exact part of the source that supports the claim.

bibliometric_credibility.title: Source quality indicators
bibliometric_credibility.0: Includes retracted or predatory sources without any warning or flag.
bibliometric_credibility.1: No filtering or labeling of source quality — all sources appear equivalent.
bibliometric_credibility.2: Categorizes sources by type (e.g., preprint vs. peer-reviewed).
bibliometric_credibility.3: Provides contextual quality indicators: retraction status, citation count, publication type, and whether the source is open access.
bibliometric_credibility.0_basic: The tool includes retracted papers or sources from unreliable publishers without warning.
bibliometric_credibility.1_basic: The tool doesn't distinguish between high-quality and low-quality sources.
bibliometric_credibility.2_basic: The tool labels whether sources are preprints or peer-reviewed.
bibliometric_credibility.3_basic: The tool shows detailed quality info for each source: retraction status, citation counts, and publication type.
